svg.text: Crest Assistant - Enterprise Agentic AI Knowledge Assistant
System architecture | Crestline Commercial Bank (fictional) | FastAPI + LangGraph + Pinecone hybrid RAG + RLM + MCP + LangSmith
Chat: multi-turn + token streaming + Sources expander
Agent Activity panel: live SSE events (node, state,
retrieval, tool, memory, validation, rlm, final)
Structured JSON logs (log_event) on every guard/tool/LLM failure
LangGraph StateGraph - one typed AgentState, each node returns only the keys it owns, MemorySaver checkpointer (needed for interrupt())
fail -> regenerate ONCE with validator feedback (hallucinated citation / no grounding)
-> final SSE event: answer + sources + trace_id
admin asks to re-index -> graph PAUSES at tool_gate.
Rejected -> tool never runs; answer says so.
Backing services (numbered badges on nodes show who calls what)
70B llama-3.3-70b-versatile: RLM plan, reduce, final answer
8B llama-3.1-8b-instant: routing, map sub-agents, tool args, facts
retry x2 -> other model -> heuristic route / extractive answer
ONE dotproduct index: dense MiniLM-384 x alpha + BM25 sparse x (1-alpha)
any failure/timeout(15 s) -> local numpy + rank-BM25, flagged degraded
list_docs / contains / select_sections - all bound to the Principal
client spawns server per call; param allow-list + charset check
unreachable -> ConnectionError -> tool error shown to user
1 working: last 6 messages verbatim (follow-ups: 'the second one')
2 rolling summary: >10 msgs -> older turns compressed (<=120 words)
3 long-term facts per user (JSON; Redis/Pinecone in prod),
extracted only when message looks personal (saves LLM calls)
sessions isolated per user; recall = keyword overlap, top 3
